scope: Prespecified generic five-band EQ training augmentation. Original-validation selection and existing development regression only; no reserved/P4/human acceptance.

extraction_audit.scope:
Audit complete EQ views against immutable original and pilot feature arrays.

Does not score a detector or load microphone captures. Reports aggregate
provenance, split isolation, numeric bounds and deterministic pilot replay.
extraction_audit.limits: Extraction/provenance audit only. No recognition, P4 or human acceptance.

equal_mean.scope: Validation-only frozen equal mean; no development/reserved/physical acceptance

known_private_cue_diagnostic.scope: One previously observed missed synthetic playback capture; post-calibration diagnostic only, not independent acceptance or threshold selection. Unchanged16kHz PCM,gain1,offset0,original speed. Raw audio remains private.

original.scope:
Frozen-model gain/arrival-phase diagnostic on explicit captured PCM only.

This never selects a threshold, trains a model or changes live audio. Offset
adds silence before the identical ordered recording; gains keep sample rate,
sample count and speed. Reports are diagnostic, not independent wake trials.

limits: Reused development regression and correlated TTS views do not establish independent population performance.
One capture spectrum/margin does not isolate microphone response or justify fitting a measured filter.
Only the USB development panel is eligible for later physical follow-up; production panel excluded.
